facts.fact: Meera's count holds a page from the Rope-Hut where she wrote Rohan as 'Warden. The noose.'; at Ranu she cannot add a line beneath it.
A drover in a felt cap stacks split pitch-pine at the foot of Ranu's lane against the last wall, planted as a clue to the 'cleansing'; Nimmi notes nobody in Ranu burns pitch-pine.
Rohan has believed the Closing Law for twelve years.
Rohan's 'Until then I carry every bucket' is a sincere bound promise; the rope hums low and level (applies F149).
Ch19 ends with eight days to the Fair and the door rule biting after the sixth day, per F290 and F292; Nimmi's untreated count is 'twenty-three, no course' (supersedes F280's 'thirty-four cups').
